headline: Tempo completed as amended; full rest tomorrow
summary: The early-morning brief recommended rest because Garmin recorded 5h 55m sleep, sleep score 58, sleeping HR 68 bpm, HRV 34 ms, Body Battery 42, and Training Readiness 52. You chose the planned group tempo and completed 5.41 km in 30m 33s. Garmin identifies 3.00 km of interval-active running in 15m 15s (5:05/km); the report preserves the earlier conservative recommendation and retains full rest for Tuesday.

yesterday.title: Morning easy-run prescription versus a cycling session
yesterday.summary: The prior morning report prescribed 35–45 minutes easy running; its later update recorded the completed cycling session and advised no further training. Garmin recorded one cycling activity on 13 September.
yesterday.prescribed: 35–45 minutes easy and conversational running, with no intervals, hills, tempo running, or strides. The approved lower-load alternative was 20–30 minutes walking or rest.
yesterday.completed: One cycling activity: 30.52 km in 1h 09m 31s, average HR 144, maximum HR 167, training load 114, aerobic effect 3.2, anaerobic effect 1.4, and 306 m elevation gain.
yesterday.adherence_assessment: The ride was not the prescribed easy run or an approved lower-load alternative. Its duration and training load were greater than the planned session.
adherence_evidence: Garmin lists one cycling activity with a 13 September Sydney start time and no run.
The ride lasted 1h 09m 31s and carried training load 114.
Garmin recorded aerobic effect 3.2 and anaerobic effect 1.4.
adherence_caveats: Garmin cannot verify perceived effort, pain, illness, terrain intent, or why the activity was completed.
Heart-rate data may differ across devices; no alternate-sensor data was used.

environment.observed_temperature_range: 19–28°C recorded by the Garmin device during the ride.
environment.humidity_dew_point_context: A reliable route-time Sydney humidity and dew-point estimate was not available, so none was used.
environment.heat_impact_interpretation: Warmer device readings could contribute to heart rate or pace. This is coaching context, not proof of heat strain and did not determine adherence.
environment.limitations: Garmin temperature is a device measurement and may be affected by body heat and local exposure; it is not an official city observation.

recommendation.title: No further training today; full rest tomorrow
details: The planned group tempo is complete. Do no further running, riding, strides, hills, tempo work, or make-up distance today.
Tuesday 15 September: full rest from running and cycling. Optional 15–20 minutes of easy walking or gentle mobility only.
Resume the weekly plan only after tomorrow's rest and the next overnight recovery check.
recommendation.alternative: Complete rest for the remainder of today and tomorrow is the safe lower-load option.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop optional activity for pain, illness, dizziness, altered gait, unusual fatigue, chest symptoms, or other concerning symptoms. Symptoms and medical advice override Garmin scores.

Today's stress and Body Battery values are incomplete morning measures.
Sleeping-heart-rate baselines exclude the current night and use the prior seven and fourteen valid nights.
Garmin device temperature and city-level weather estimates are distinct from route-level conditions.

run_assessments.morning_recommendation: Full rest from training, based on short sleep and reduced recovery signals; optional gentle walking or mobility only.
run_assessments.amended_plan: Controlled group tempo, with planned warm-up and cool-down, no added distance or repetitions, then full rest on Tuesday.
run_assessments.completed: Sydney W3 Mon Tempo: 5.41 km in 30m 33s, average pace 5:39/km, average HR 154 bpm, max HR 179 bpm, training load 98, aerobic effect 3.2, anaerobic effect 0.0, and Garmin training-effect label TEMPO.
run_assessments.pace_assessment: Garmin's interval-active segments total 3.00 km in 15m 15s, or 5:05/km. That is the appropriate pace measure for the work; the overall session pace is diluted by 3m 30s of interval recovery, walking, warm-up and cool-down. The interval-active block included 31.9 m of ascent, and Garmin's device temperature range was 21–27°C; those are contextual factors, not proof of heat strain.
run_assessments.assessment_basis: The activity matches the amended controlled-tempo plan. The snapshot cannot verify subjective effort, whether every planned repetition was completed, or whether any non-recorded work was added.
